code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Grid intersections are the rows and columns containing mostly the line color.
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) <= 3 and grid[r].count(9) > w//2] if 9 in sum(grid, []) else []
    # Generalize: boundary lines are the most common color in input.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(bg) >= w-1]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if sum(row[c] == bg for row in grid) >= h-1]
    # interior/base color is the most common non-line color
    base = Counter(x for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if r not in rs and c not in cs).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r,c in [(rs[i],cs[j]),(rs[i],cs[j+1]),(rs[i+1],cs[j]),(rs[i+1],cs[j+1])]]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0] != bg and vals.count(vals[0]) == 4 else base)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    line=max(set(sum(grid,[])), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x)>=w-2 for row in grid))
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(line)>=w-2]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if sum(row[c]==line for row in grid)>=h-2]
    from collections import Counter
    base=Counter(x for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if r not in rs and c not in cs).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            vals=[grid[rs[i]][cs[j]],grid[rs[i]][cs[j+1]],grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j]],grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j+1]]]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0]!=line and all(x==vals[0] for x in vals) else base)
        out.append(row)
    active=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(out) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v!=base]
    if active:
        r0,r1=min(i for i,j in active),max(i for i,j in active)
        c0,c1=min(j for i,j in active),max(j for i,j in active)
        out=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
    return out
